label: D1-only: high after an unrewarded a1->S1 trial, boosted by repeated S1 visits; suppressed after a2.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2), decaying over the episode (timing baseline). Magnitude beyond timing is driven by the last trial: largest after a common a1->S1 unrewarded trial (~+0.3), moderate after a1->S1 rewarded, and below baseline after any a2 or S2 trial. Consecutive S1 visits (trial before also reached S1, and longer S1 streaks) add further, so long a1->S1 runs give ~0.7 and an unrewarded one at the end of such a run ~1.2. The free fit adds the a1 S1 u x S1-before interaction, S1 streak length and the reward two trials back. Belief log-odds adds little; the observed-cue ceiling is only ~0.39, so a sizeable part (e.g. windows where it is zero despite a1->S1 history) is not captured by observed history.
